items.title: Harry Fairconnetue Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You remember big head Eddie Johnson? I remember that. [INTERVIEWEE] You don't be getting there, you just wait for it.

ctx.x: So, however, we made out that night. So, from that night on, I said, well, I'm going to make a change up in the line. Well, Eddie is alright, he's telling everything. I have nothing against him. He's in a swell drama.
Yeah, he's a nice punk. But Eddie was getting old and he's coming to cramp in his legs.
So, I had a job coming up. And he was coming up with the four people. And he was coming up with the four people. And he was coming up with the four people.
